title: Elegí el mundo visual de HS500 Pulso
question: La tirada asignó Envase farmacéutico suizo. Quedátelo, elegí una alternativa o tirá de nuevo.

options.label: Envase farmacéutico suizo
options.thesis: The pulse reads like the dosage on a pack: one number, one strength-coded colour band.
options.viewport: A graphite window; the top half is a colour band in the zone's code colour carrying the BPM as a giant DIN number, with status, history and VRChat sending below.
options.risk: If the band does not change colour with the zone, it is just one more dark dashboard.

raised.raise: Numbers sit in fixed cells: going from 99 to 100 never shifts the layout.
The history keeps one fixed scale and baseline (40–200 bpm), so minutes compare against each other.
When the strap disconnects, everything except the status dims.
One 1px grey hairline divides every region; no boxes or shadows.

options.label: Dorsal de carrera
options.thesis: Your pulse pinned to your chest like a race bib number.
options.viewport: A white bib with a red stripe on top, the BPM huge in black at the centre, pin holes in the corners, settings below the bib.
options.risk: Familiar (fitness apps go there), and a white window glares in a dark headset at night.

options.label: Señalética de aeropuerto
options.thesis: Every state is a yellow sign band: one message per line, the number at monumental scale.
options.viewport: A yellow band with the BPM, then black bands 'Banda → conectada' and 'VRChat → 127.0.0.1:9000' with arrows.
options.case: Unbeatable for glanceability; it loses on identification, and the yellow fights the zone colours.
options.risk: Fixed yellow leaves no room for colour to code the zone.

options.label: Split-flap board
options.thesis: The BPM changes digit by digit like a departure board.
options.viewport: Rows of flaps with BPM, battery and OSC state.
options.case: The audience doesn't identify with it, and the per-digit cascade adds noise to a number that changes every second.
options.kept: Numbers in fixed cells that never shift the layout.

options.label: Botanical folio
options.thesis: The session as a sequence of plates at the same scale.
options.case: Contemplative where you need a glance; it loses on both axes.
options.risk: Cream and serif: the default rut.
options.kept: One fixed scale and baseline for the history.

options.label: Streaming wall
options.thesis: Settings as tiles that grow on focus.
options.viewport: Rows of tiles: strap, chatbox, parameters.
options.case: A catalogue navigation model for an app with one screen; it loses on both axes.
options.kept: Whatever doesn't matter right now dims behind the main element.

options.label: Star atlas
options.thesis: Beats as stars on a chart.
options.case: Pretty, but nobody reads a pulse as a constellation; it loses on both axes.
options.kept: Size, not weight, carries the hierarchy.

options.label: Design annual plates
options.thesis: Each region is a registered plate.
options.case: Glares in VR and reads as editorial, not as a tool; it loses on both axes.
options.risk: Light ground in a dark scene.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What a heart-rate fitness app ships, done well.
canonCard.viewport: A dark background, a red heart beside the number, cards for each setting.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from any HR app by design.
